'''Pippa Rosheed''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who worked as a [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] and a [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologist]]. She was a member of [[Lexi Fernandin]]'s scouting expedition to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] a couple of years after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==Biography==
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] Pippa Rosheed grew up with an interest in both exploration, and the study of other life forms. She attended university, and studied to become a [[Xenobiologist/Legends|xenobiologist]], joining [[Fernandin Scouting Expedition]] after graduation. Rosheed began working for them in the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] reign,<ref name="GG2-2">[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]]</ref> working for them for many [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="GG2-1" />

Rosheed participated in the exploration of dozens of [[Star system/Legends|star systems]], until the Empire began to restrict<ref name="GG2-1" /> non-military exploration. Accepting a teaching position at [[Sperinad University]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]], she became a successful teacher and scholar although she missed field work. Rosheed maintained contact with [[Lexi Fernandin]], head of Fernandin Scouting Company, and jumped at chance to get back into the field when the Empire awarded the company the rights to explore the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]]. She resigned her position at the university with immediate effect.<ref name="GG2-2" />

==Personality and traits==
Pippa Rosheed was 1.42 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall, and although she looked aged, she had an ageless quality.<ref name="GG2-1" /> She had a distant look to her eyes, giving the impression that she was looking past any individual she was talking to. Petite and nervous, Rosheed was constantly moving<ref name="GG2-2" /> in a economical, alert fashion.<ref name="GG2-1" /> A loner, she was shy and generally distrustful of strangers, although she had a hard, serious exterior and rarely showed emotion unless engaged in new biological or medical discoveries.<ref name="GG2-2" />

==Skills and abilities==
Rosheed was a skill biologist, doctor, and scholar, with knowledge in the practical application of first aid, and advanced medical knowledge. She was skilled in survival techniques, and was knowledgeable about [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and [[Computer/Legends|computer]] programming and repair.<ref name="GG2-2" />

==Equipment==
During expeditions, Rosheed armed herself with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], and carried a [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]], a week's worth of [[Ration pack/Legends|ration packs]], and a length of vine [[Rope/Legends|rope]]. She also carried a [[Knife/Legends|knife]] and [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], as well as a [[Medpac/Legends|medpac]] and an assortment of jungle [[Plant/Legends|herbs]].<ref name="GG2-1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pippa Rosheed was designed for inclusion in the [[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin|first edition]] of ''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]], a supplement to ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]] that was published by [[West End Games]] first in [[1989]] and then reprinted into a [[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|second edition]] in [[1995]].
